narr: A corridor of thunderstorms from Neosho to Cassville to Branson occurred during the evening of September 20th. These thunderstorms moved over the same areas causing damaging winds and flash flooding. Up to 6 inches of rainfall occurred over a 12 hour period across portions of Barry County.
ev: State Highway 86 was closed due to flooding just southeast of Cassville.

Water was over Highway 37 just south of Cassville and intersections that normally flood were completely impassable.
Flash flooding occurred along County Road 2220 with the entire road covered.
